articles.title: Asmara Heritage Project: Documenting a Colonial Project that Became Eritrea's National Symbol
articles.summary: Asmara , the capital of Eritrea , sits at over 2,300 meters above sea level on a plateau at the edge of the Great Rift Valley escarpment. Although situated in a country not known for large visitor numbers, the city has gained fame for its unique architecture . In July 2017, it became a UNESCO World Heritage Site , inscribed as "Asmara: A Modernist African City," the first modernist urban site anywhere to be listed in its entirety, and Africa's first explicitly modernist World Heritage Site. articles.title: Lorne Road House / Foomann Architects
articles.summary: Lorne Road is a semi-detached Edwardian cottage. Renovated several years after its neighbour, the alteration is sympathetic to the heritage and contemporary buildings, and the calm and cohesive interior is subtly embellished with gentle curves, eclectic details and atmospheric light. The clients, a family of five, engaged Foomann to refresh the heritage part of their house and design a two-storey extension accommodating a new living space, playroom, main bedroom and mezzanine study.

articles.title: Đông Triều Retreat / NAQI & Partners
articles.summary: Dong Trieu Retreat is a collection of small structures nestled within the lush landscape of Quang Ninh, Vietnam. Originally conceived as a simple weekend retreat for a family from Ha Long, it gradually became their permanent home. Within this setting, we were entrusted with designing several spaces dedicated to restoration and renewal: a kitchen and dining area, a tea room, a sauna, and a meditation pavilion overlooking a water lily pond.

articles.title: Shenzhen Futian Lvzhou Primary School / CCDI Dongxiying Studio
articles.summary: Campus in a Village-Town — Xinzhou, located on the south side of Futian Central Area in Shenzhen , is an important residential and living district. Over the years, it has developed a unique blend of commercial, residential, and urban village spaces. This rich urban fabric has fostered diverse communities and vibrant street life. Having settled in Shenzhen early on, I once lived in Xinzhou for seven years. articles.title: Casa Honor Vacui / Equipo de Arquitectura
articles.summary: Space is an architectural, and therefore physical, dimension that constitutes the essence of our profession and, at the same time, an abstract configuration of matter. Natural light gives that matter its character: it lends it depth, accentuates its textures, and shapes the junctions between elements. Together, light and the envelope that defines a space construct the experience of inhabiting it.

articles.title: Crismina Fort Refurbishment  / barbiniarquitectos
articles.summary: The Crismina fort is one of the three XVIII century forts of the old defense line of the coast of Cascais , following the conflict between Portugal and Spain. This fortified structure is mainly an empty space, fenced by walls, partly deteriorated by wind erosion and other atmospheric phenomena. The walls have different heights and thickness defining an irregular polygon.

articles.title: Casa Bajura / MAPA Arquitectos LLC
articles.summary: Building on Puerto Rico's northern coast means responding to heat, humidity, salinity, hurricanes, flooding and the realities of island life, where available resources and materials inevitably shape architecture. The house emerges from its territory. Climate, culture and local material conditions inform every design decision, creating a space that encourages a more conscious way of inhabiting place.

articles.title: Bothanic Faria Lima Building / Del Bianco Arquitetos + AMZ Arquitetos
articles.summary: Located in the country's main financial hub, just one block from the bustling Faria Lima Avenue, one of the key conditions for the building's insertion was the preservation and enhancement of the abundant existing vegetation on-site before construction, including species that could not be relocated, such as a Brazilwood tree.

articles.title: Again, a Garden Temporary Installation / Hugh Taylor
articles.summary: Designed for the International Garden Festival at the Jardins de Métis in Grand-Métis, Québec, "Again, a Garden" is a temporary pavilion composed of hundreds of logs sourced from the surrounding forest and aluminum plates that enclose a wildflower garden. It is both a physical and figurative structure for human and floral occupation. The visitor is placed, literally and figuratively, between the logs and the life they support.

Now Copenhagen-based furniture designer Chiara Verde proposes an alternative suspended seating surface: Laminated cork. articles.title: Why Did the Aerodynamic Look Go Away, and Will It Come Back?
articles.summary: For automakers on the cusp of the 1990s, interest in aerodynamic efficiency was high. This yielded popular cars—the 1988 Honda CRX, the 1989 Ford Thunderbird, the 1990 Mazda RX-7—with drag coefficients (Cd) around 0.32. This aerodynamic sculpting also yielded, to my eye, good-looking and well-proportioned cars. In the 1990s, the rise of the SUV seemed to deprioritize aerodynamics, as we climbed into ever-more blocky-looking trucks.
